title: Complex multi-medication reconciliation
description: Multiple sources contain continued, changed, discontinued, new, and conflicting medication information.

sources.name: Previous Medication List
sources.text: Metformin 500 mg orally twice daily. Amlodipine 5 mg orally once daily. Lisinopril 10 mg orally once daily.

sources.name: Discharge Summary
sources.text: Continue Metformin 500 mg orally twice daily. Increase Amlodipine to 10 mg orally once daily. Discontinue Lisinopril. Start Atorvastatin 20 mg orally once daily.

sources.name: Patient Interview
sources.text: Patient confirms Metformin 500 mg twice daily and Atorvastatin 20 mg once daily, but reports still taking Amlodipine 5 mg once daily.
